meta.source: Block Concepts brand guide v1, the RAD Process Word document, the Block Concepts website spec (Oct 14 2026) and the homepage prototype

tokens.name: bc-surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-black on the website, white in documents and proposals.

tokens.name: bc-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the cookie panel, the footer and open pillar panels, one step above bc-surface. Pair with bc-hairline.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Callouts, table headers and highlighted panels. Text on it is bc-steel-blue-text (6.12:1 dark, 5.78:1 light).

tokens.name: bc-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders and section rules (white at about 12% on the dark ground). Decorative only, 1.36:1 on dark bc-surface: never the only cue for a control; use bc-steel-blue-text or bc-ink for a control border.

tokens.name: bc-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bc-surface and bc-surface-raised (17.61:1 and 15.87:1 dark, 16.06:1 light).

tokens.name: bc-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata and legal links on bc-surface and bc-surface-raised (8.26:1 and 7.44:1 dark; 6.11:1 and 5.64:1 light).

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue
tokens.usage: The brand blue. BLOCK in the wordmark, buttons, tags, progress bars, rules, diagrams and headings 24px and larger in documents. 4.76:1 on dark bc-surface, 4.29:1 on dark bc-surface-raised, 4.11:1 on white: never for text under 24px on raised or white (use bc-steel-blue-text).

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows, pillar labels, tag text and the focus ring: Steel Blue text under 24px. 7.98:1 on dark bc-surface and 7.19:1 on bc-surface-raised; 6.72:1 on white in the light theme. The brand guide listed #6FA3D2 for dark; the website uses #7FAAD0.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Fill of a primary button on hover or press. White label on it is 5.34:1.

tokens.name: bc-on-steel-blue
tokens.usage: Label on a bc-steel-blue fill, such as buttons and tags. 4.11:1: fine for 16px semibold and up per the Block Concepts guide, below the 4.5:1 AA floor for normal text, so keep these labels at 16px semibold or larger (tags are 11px uppercase and miss it; keep them to short words).

tokens.name: bc-wordmark-gray
tokens.usage: CONCEPTS in the wordmark only. Never text or UI. 8.26:1 on dark bc-surface; 3.07:1 on white, display size only.

tokens.name: bc-mark-print
tokens.usage: Colour of the master mark file and of headings in the current Word documents. Light grounds only (7.0:1 on white); it is 2.79:1 on dark bc-surface, so the website uses the dark mark in bc-steel-blue.

tokens.name: bc-placeholder
tokens.usage: Ground of an image placeholder (the striped panel standing in for a CAD render). Replaced when the render exists.

tokens.name: bc-placeholder-alt
tokens.usage: Second stripe of an image placeholder, beside bc-placeholder.

tokens.name: bc-placeholder-text
tokens.usage: Caption inside an image placeholder, such as IMAGE · Engineering render. 4.71:1 on bc-placeholder dark, 5.39:1 light.

tokens.name: bc-doc-ink
tokens.usage: Body and table text in Word documents (the current RAD Process document sets body text in black).

tokens.name: bc-doc-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptor lines, the confidentiality notice and secondary text in Word documents. 7.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: bc-doc-table-header
tokens.usage: Fill of a Word table header row, with a white bold label (4.48:1, bold so it holds as large text).

tokens.name: bc-doc-table-zebra
tokens.usage: Alternate row fill in Word tables.

tokens.name: bc-doc-rule
tokens.usage: Cell borders in Word tables, 0.5pt.

styles.name: site-pillar
styles.usage: Pillar names on the homepage panels, 30px on phones. Uppercase. bc-ink (bc-steel-blue when the panel is open).

styles.name: site-headline
styles.usage: The position headline, 32px on phones. Uppercase. bc-ink.
styles.sample: SMALL FIXES AND FULL PRODUCTION LINES.

styles.name: site-section
styles.usage: Section titles such as Solutions, 36px on phones. Uppercase. bc-ink.

styles.name: site-cta
styles.usage: Contact and call-to-action headlines, 36px on phones. Uppercase. bc-ink.

styles.name: site-getto
styles.usage: The Get to know us link, 26px on phones. Uppercase. bc-ink.

styles.name: site-body
styles.usage: Body copy, 17px on phones, line height 1.6, 65 characters wide at most. bc-muted for the main paragraph, bc-ink for the caption beneath it.
styles.sample: Block Concepts owns it from the first conversation to a running system.

styles.name: site-card-title
styles.usage: Titles on solution tiles and tier rows. bc-ink.

styles.name: site-nav
styles.usage: Navigation and footer links, 12px on phones. Uppercase. 0.06em tracking in the header, 0.04em in the footer.

styles.name: site-button
styles.usage: Button labels. Uppercase. 0.06em tracking. 16px semibold is the minimum on a bc-steel-blue fill.

styles.name: site-small
styles.usage: Legal row, copyright line, cookie banner text. bc-muted.

styles.name: site-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and pillar labels (Design, Distribution, Integration), 12px on phones. Uppercase. 0.12em tracking, bc-steel-blue-text.

styles.name: site-tag
styles.usage: Industry and pillar tags on solution tiles, and placeholder captions. Uppercase. 0.06em tracking.

styles.name: wordmark-block
styles.usage: BLOCK in the wordmark: bc-steel-blue, caps, 0.08em tracking. 22px in the footer, 15px in the header.

styles.name: wordmark-concepts
styles.usage: CONCEPTS in the wordmark: bc-wordmark-gray, caps, 0.08em tracking.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Cover title (34pt bold), centered, bc-mark-print.

styles.name: doc-subtitle
styles.usage: Cover subtitle (17pt), centered, bc-mark-print.

styles.name: doc-lead
styles.usage: Cover summary sentence (13pt), centered, bc-doc-secondary.
styles.sample: A phased framework for developing custom automation.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Heading 1 (20pt, 18pt space before, 4pt after), bc-mark-print.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: Heading 2 (16pt, 8pt space before, 4pt after), bc-mark-print.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: Stage and packet headings (11.5pt bold), bc-doc-ink.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Body text (10.5pt), 6pt space after, line spacing 1.04, bc-doc-ink.
styles.sample: Each stage closes at a milestone with a defined deliverable.

styles.name: doc-table
styles.usage: Table text (10.5pt). Header cells bold white on bc-doc-table-header.

styles.name: doc-notice
styles.usage: Confidentiality notice (9pt italic), bc-doc-secondary.
styles.sample: CONFIDENTIAL — This document contains proprietary information.

tokens.name: bc-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps and tight label spacing. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bc-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control, button vertical padding. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bc-space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a table cell or a nav link group. Added to the brand guide's four steps.

tokens.name: bc-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones, minimum logo clear space. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bc-space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between a heading and its text. Added to the brand guide's four steps.

tokens.name: bc-space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between stacked blocks. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bc-space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on phones. Added to the brand guide's four steps.

tokens.name: bc-space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section on desktop. Added to the brand guide's four steps.

tokens.name: bc-radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, the hero, section bands and diagram boxes.

tokens.name: bc-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: bc-radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and callouts. The maximum radius anywhere.
